Emergency Breakdown Recovery Birmingham

When your vehicle breaks down, you need help fast, not a long list of maybes. A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides emergency breakdown recovery across Birmingham, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.Whether you've stopped on a local road, outside your home, in a car park, or mid-journey, our team gets to you quickly and sorts out the right solution: roadside assistance, full vehicle recovery, or transport to a garage or destination of your choice.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote Get a free Quote

Tell us what's happened — we'll call you back within minutes.

24/7 Emergency Breakdown Recovery in Birmingham

Breakdowns don't wait for convenient timing. Early morning, late at night, weekends, rush hour whenever your vehicle lets you down, we're on call. A.A.D Transport & Recovery covers roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, day or night.

When you call, just tell us: 

  • Your exact location
  • Your vehicle make and model
  • What's gone wrong

We'll take it from there and get the right recovery option moving.

What Is Emergency Breakdown Recovery?

Emergency breakdown recovery covers any situation where your vehicle has stopped working or isn't safe to drive. Common causes include:

  • Engine or mechanical failure
  • Battery or electrical faults
  • Starting problems
  • Flat or damaged tyres
  • Fuel issues
  • Overheating
  • Dashboard warning lights
  • Accident damage
  • A vehicle that's simply unsafe to drive

Sometimes a quick fix at the roadside gets you back on the road. Other times, your vehicle needs to be recovered and transported to a garage, home, or another location either way, we handle it.

Get A Quote

Car Breakdown Recovery Birmingham

A broken-down car is stressful enough without confusion over what happens next. Our car breakdown recovery service in Birmingham is built to get you moving again with minimum fuss.

We recover vehicles from across the city at home, on local roads, in car parks, or wherever you've come to a stop (subject to safe access). You tell us the situation; we arrange the recovery and get your vehicle where it needs to go, safely and without delay.

Emergency Roadside Recovery

Not every breakdown means your car needs transporting.

If it's something like a starting fault that can potentially be sorted at the roadside, we'll try that first. If the vehicle still can't be made safe to drive, we move straight to recovery no unnecessary steps, no confusion about what happens next.

Vehicle Recovery to a Garage

If your vehicle needs professional repair, we'll transport it there directly. You choose the destination:

  • Your local garage
  • A repair centre
  • Your home
  • A dealership
  • Another location of your choice

This is especially useful for non-running vehicles that simply can't be driven anywhere.

Get A Quote

Breakdown Recovery for Non-Running Vehicles

A car that won't start can't just be driven onto a truck it needs proper recovery equipment, and that's exactly what we use.

To help us prepare the right equipment before we arrive, let us know:

  • Whether the engine starts
  • Whether the wheels can roll
  • Whether the vehicle is in neutral
  • Whether there's accident damage
  • Whether the vehicle is easily accessible

The more detail you give us, the faster we can get moving.

Emergency Recovery After an Accident

If you've been in a collision, safety comes first. If there's any immediate danger, call the emergency services straight away. Once you and everyone else is safe, we can recover your vehicle from the roadside and transport it to a agreed destination like:

Garage Repair Centre Home Other Place Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

Breakdown Recovery Across Birmingham

A.A.D Transport & Recovery is based on Walsall Road, Birmingham, and operates 24/7 across the city and surrounding areas, including:

  • Birmingham City Centre
  • Aston
  • Erdington
  • Perry Barr
  • Handsworth
  • Harborne
  • Edgbaston
  • Selly Oak
  • Moseley
  • Kings Heath
  • Yardley
  • Sheldon
  • Sutton Coldfield
  • And surrounding areas

Not sure if we cover your exact location? Just call — we'll confirm straight away.

Breaking Down on a Busy Road

If you break down somewhere busy:

01

Step

Call 07771 004242 with your location and a brief description of the problem.

02

Step

We tell you which vehicle we're sending and an estimated arrival time.

03

Step

On motorways or high-speed roads, follow official road safety guidance and call emergency services if there's any danger

04

Step

When you call us, give your exact location, road name, direction of travel, and the nearest junction or landmark

Clear location details mean we find you faster.

Why Choose A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

24/7 Availability

We're on call around the clock breakdowns don't stick to office hours, and neither do we.

Local Birmingham Service

Based in Birmingham, covering Birmingham. You get a local team that knows the area.

Clear Communication

We talk you through what's happening and what to expect before recovery starts no jargon, no guesswork.

Vehicle Transportation

Wherever your vehicle needs to go garage, home, dealership we get it there safely.

Practical, No-Nonsense Support

Roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment, handled by people who do this every day.

What To Do When Your Car Breaks Down

Move to a safe position

if it's safe to do so, get the vehicle away from moving traffic.

Turn on hazard lights

warn other drivers your vehicle has stopped.

Check your surroundings

take extra care on busy roads, dual carriageways and motorways.

Call us

give us your exact location and explain what's happened.

Share your vehicle details

make, model, registration, and whether it can start or move.

Follow our instructions

we'll guide you through the rest.

How Emergency Breakdown Recovery Works

Simple, fast, and stress-free — exactly what you need in a breakdown.

  • Call us — tell us where you are and what's happened.
  • Give vehicle details — make, model, and the nature of the fault.
  • We assess the situation — roadside assistance, recovery, or transportation.
  • Recovery is arranged — we get moving straight away.
  • Your vehicle is transported — safely, to your chosen destination.
  Get A Quote

When Should You Call Emergency Breakdown Recovery?

Call us if your vehicle:

  • Won't start
  • Has stopped unexpectedly
  • Has a serious mechanical problem
  • Isn't safe to drive
  • Has been damaged in an accident
  • Needs transporting to a garage
  • Can't continue its journey
  • Is stuck in an unsuitable location

Not sure if it's safe to drive? Don't risk it — call us and we'll advise on the best next step.

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

What is emergency breakdown recovery in Birmingham?

It’s assistance for vehicles that have stopped working or can’t safely continue their journey covering roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, or moving a non-running vehicle to a garage, home, or other destination.

Does A.A.D Transport & Recovery provide 24/7 breakdown recovery?

Yes — we’re available around the clock, every day of the week.

Can you recover a car that won't start?

Yes. Let us know whether the engine starts and whether the vehicle can move, and we’ll bring the right recovery equipment.

Can you take my broken-down car to a garage?

Yes, vehicle transportation to a garage or another agreed destination is one of our core services.

Do you provide roadside breakdown assistance?

Yes. Depending on the fault, we’ll try roadside assistance first, or move straight to recovery if needed.

Can you recover a vehicle after an accident?

Yes, once you’re safe. We’ll transport the vehicle to a suitable location as part of the recovery.

How quickly can a recovery vehicle arrive?

It depends on your location, traffic, and current demand. Call us with your exact location for the most accurate estimate.

Do you provide breakdown recovery outside Birmingham?

We’re based in Birmingham and cover the surrounding areas call us with your location and we’ll confirm availability.

What information should I provide when calling for recovery?

Your exact location, vehicle make and model, registration, a description of the fault, and whether the vehicle can start or move. On a major road, also share the road name, direction of travel, and nearest junction or landmark.

What if I break down on a motorway?

Prioritise safety first and follow motorway breakdown guidance. Call emergency services if there’s danger. Once safe, call us with your location and vehicle details.

Need Emergency Breakdown Recovery in Birmingham?

Stopped, stranded, or just need your car moved to a garage A.A.D Transport & Recovery is here 24/7 with roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment across Birmingham and the surrounding areas.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote
